notes: Covers all 3 routes registered in AppManager.setupRoutes, plus the unmatched-route 404.
The database is SQLite :memory:, so the whole spec must be captured in ONE server run;
restarting resets to the boot seeds and renumbers every autoincrement id.
Order is deliberate: read the seeded state, then error paths, then writes, then re-read
to observe them, then the destructive delete and a re-read that exposes the orphans.
Step checkout-declined uses a distinct email on purpose: the declined path still commits
the user row (DAT-02), so the baseline records that behaviour rather than hiding it.
Two crash probes are kept out of this spec because they terminate the process and would
fail every later step; they live in ecommerce-api-legacy.crash.json and are captured
one at a time against a freshly started server.
The two report steps are declared unordered because the legacy handler resolves them
with manual counters and pushes rows in callback-completion order (API-01): capturing
the UNCHANGED app twice produced different course and student orders, so no fixed order
can be the contract. Every element is still compared; only position is ignored.
